name: vLLM
summary: Serves an open-weights model on the server's NVIDIA GPU over an OpenAI-compatible API, as a model in the Supply Depot.
requires: NVIDIA GPU with its driver installed
passwordless sudo for the login user

settings.label: Model
settings.help: A Hugging Face model id. It must fit the GPU: a 24 GB card (RTX 3090) runs about 14B parameters at 4-bit (AWQ) with a long context.

settings.label: Name bots see
settings.help: The model name in API calls.

settings.label: Share of GPU memory to use
settings.help: Lower it if other work on this server needs the GPU too.

settings.label: Tool-call parser
settings.help: How vLLM reads the model's tool calls. hermes suits Qwen models; see vLLM's tool calling docs for others.

settings.label: Listen address
settings.help: 0.0.0.0 answers on every interface. Give the server's LAN address to keep it off others. Every call needs the API key either way.

settings.label: Docker image
settings.help: Pin a version tag to stop upgrades on reinstall. The image digest that ran is on the record.

settings.label: Extra vLLM arguments
settings.help: Passed to vLLM as they are, e.g. --enable-prefix-caching.

secrets.label: API key
secrets.help: Generated by ORBOT and kept in the secrets store; every call to the API must carry it.

secrets.label: Hugging Face token
secrets.help: Only for gated or private models. Store it as a credential first.
